headlines.text: On a Wednesday in 2025, back when Konosuke Takeshita vs. Orange Cassidy fought tooth and nail for the AEW International Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.40 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle. In a first-ever singles meeting between the two International Title mainstays, Takeshita reversed an Orange Punch attempt into a Raging Fire to retain the championship over Cassidy.

Back on this day in 2020, Kenny Omega vs. PAC settled things in an Iron Man (30 Minutes) match, kicking off the show on Dynamite, rated 9.14 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype. An ambitious 30-minute Iron Man match opening the entire show ? a chair shot disqualification, a shooting star press through a table, and a sudden-death overtime finish, in a match widely called one of the best AEW had produced to that point.
On this day in 2025, Lance Archer was back in action after 7 weeks away, appearing on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: That Wednesday in 2020, Yuka Sakazaki returned to the fold after a long-awaited absence after 8 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
Flash back to 2020, when Jurassic Express (Trio) vs. Proud-N-Powerful & Guevara met for the very first time on Dynamite, rated 6.38.
2025 brought us this moment: Will Ospreay vs. Bryan Keith met for the very first time on Dynamite, rated 7.17 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
